verdict.rationale: Event-triggered automation exists but mostly through an external tool or fixed built-in behaviors. Zapier connects Granola to 8,000+ apps to automate what happens after a meeting. Natively, HubSpot auto-syncs notes added to folders, follow-up emails are auto-drafted after external meetings, and transcripts can be auto-deleted after a set period. None of this is a native, user-defined rule engine. Missing for 10: native rule builder with custom triggers/conditions/actions, detail on which Granola events can trigger Zapier, independent hands-on corroboration.
